All settings will be reset to factory defaults.

encoding.concatHint: Fast path joins clips in one pass (similar to Avidemux Copy). On errors you can cancel or use Legacy. Legacy uses the proven MPEG-TS pipeline.
encoding.introMuxHint: Re-encoding produces intro and flight video as one continuous bitstream — reliable on phones and players. Stream copy is faster but may freeze on some devices.
encoding.previewReuseHint: Tip: Generate a preview first — if clips stay unchanged, Create reuses it without re-encoding.
encoding.useLibmpvHint: Snappier scrubbing in the cutter when mpv is installed. Falls back to HTML5 if mpv is missing.

autoScan.title: Auto-scan on import
autoScan.description: After drag & drop, file pick, or SD import, new files are scanned for QR automatically. The switches are also under the media drop zone.
